title: Close match-engine privacy and replay acceptance
head: 0cb7524

gates.alembic: head unchanged t4e5f6a7b8c9 (no migration in this issue)

acceptance.ac: Maintained synthetic fixtures cover all dimensions, caps, four gap classes, unknown evidence, and score bands
acceptance.evidence: Pre-existing: test_match_assessment_policy.py (weights sum 100, exact 8-key set, cap ordering, recommendation bands), test_match_assessment_engine.py (core-skill 75 / severe-years 70 / lowest-cap caps, all four gap categories with action types), test_match_assessment_catalog.py (unknown/missing values skipped), test_match_semantic_matcher.py (unknown evidence id retry/exhaust). New: test_fixture_dimension_keys_match_weights pins the dimension/weight key set.

acceptance.ac: Same versions/policy/fake semantic output replay to the same score, caps, gaps, and explanations
acceptance.evidence: New unit tests: test_replay_same_inputs_same_result (identical MatchV1Result incl. total/before-caps/caps/gap dumps, deterministic=true) and test_replay_catalog_through_engine_is_stable (catalog -> fake semantic -> engine tuple replay stable).

acceptance.ac: Gateway spies and database/log/API checks contain no unmasked/direct-identifier canaries
acceptance.evidence: Gateway spy: test_match_semantic_matcher.py::test_classify_gateway_spy_proves_masked_allowlist_payload (payload bounded, privacy_required, Acme/email/phone absent). New integration test_completed_row_and_api_never_expose_canaries: a completed row's persisted JSON columns and the detail API response contain none of Acme/alice@example.com/13800138000 even though the seed resume profile evidence embeds them.

acceptance.ac: Broker failure, timeout, malformed output, retry, concurrent force, and stale-worker cases converge safely
acceptance.evidence: test_match_assessment_api.py covers broker failure (ASSESSMENT_DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT retryable), retry (new run, cleared diagnostic), stale worker (no rewrite of immutable result), active duplicate 409. New: test_malformed_semantic_output_persists_invalid_evidence (terminal ASSESSMENT_EVIDENCE_INVALID, no result persisted) and test_concurrent_force_create_converges_to_single_active_row (two racing force creates on one tuple -> exactly one active row via the partial unique index). Timeout path is unit-covered via MatchSemanticError(retryable=True) mapping in the worker.

acceptance.ac: Representative list/reuse queries use expected indexes and bounded query counts
acceptance.evidence: New integration test_reuse_lookup_and_target_cursor_use_indexes: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) proves ix_match_assessments_tuple_created serves the completed-reuse lookup and ix_match_assessments_target_created serves the target cursor list; both queries bounded by LIMIT.

acceptance.ac: Migration, unit, integration, lint, type, privacy, and diff gates are recorded
acceptance.evidence: Gates recorded above: alembic head unchanged (migration t4e5f6a7b8c9 from #109 covers the schema); unit/integration/lint/type/arch all pass at baseline; privacy assertions are part of the unit and integration suites. Diff is additive tests only (2 new test files).

reviews.note: All 6 acceptance criteria verified. Privacy: provider-payload masking proven by the gateway spy; DB + API canary checks added. Replay: deterministic equality proven at both the engine and catalog-through-engine levels. Convergence: malformed output -> ASSESSMENT_EVIDENCE_INVALID; concurrent force -> single active row. Index usage: EXPLAIN-based assertions on both representative queries. No production code changed; this issue is the acceptance gate only.

residual_risks: Real LLM provider path is still not exercised in integration (matcher unit tests cover the gateway adapter with fakes).
Query-bounds assertion is per-statement LIMIT; EXPLAIN proves index choice, not row-count amplification on large datasets.
